lines: West face is shut. Not unsafe, exactly. Just wrong.
Nineteen years I worked it with Roxen and it never once sounded hollow.
She gave you the Seal? Roxen doesn't hand those out, she loses them on purpose.
Then you must have made her work.
Do me a favour. When somebody official asks you what's under my quarry, tell me what they said.

km_child: I can lift a stone THIS big.
...I can push a stone this big.
Pushing is lifting sideways. Everyone knows that.
km_angler: Lake's forty metres deep and it has never frozen. Not once, not in the records.
There's a light down there. Sits still. Doesn't drift.
I've fished this water thirty years and I've never once put a hook near it.

lines: Kellowmere. Waystation east, provisioner west, Bastion straight up the road.
Bring something green or something wet. That's not a hint, that's just the type chart.
One Seal down. Seven to go, and they do not get easier.
Brackwater is the next one that will have you, but the coast road runs east from Ashgate.

km_rester: Walked up from Ashgate in one go. Do not do that.
There is a ledge halfway that you can drop down on the way home.
Only on the way home, mind. It is a ledge, not a staircase.
km_house_a: My father cut stone. His father cut stone.
I keep the accounts. Somebody has to know what the stone is worth.
Lately the Concord pays over the odds for anything from the west face. Anything at all.
km_house_b: You want the truth about the lake? Nobody knows. That is the truth about the lake.
Every seventy years it drops a metre and comes back up. Ask why and you get shrugs.
That's the Turning for you. Everything moves and nobody can say what for.
